numbering_basis: The licensor's own continuous 第1話-第8話 / Episode 1-Episode 8 across both ONA seasons. gundam-official.com's STORY index (Bandai Namco Filmworks' live CMS) emits episodeNumber 1..8 with subtile 第1話..第8話 on the JA locale and Episode 1..Episode 8 on the EN locale, in one list; Gundam.info's season-2 announcement writes 「アニメ第2シーズンとなる第5話から第8話」; the legacy official site's STORY artwork is act01..act08. Only the production ASSET filenames keep a per-season index (TB_1st_sc_ep01-04, TB_2nd_sc_ep01-04). So our run numbering 1-4 (AniList 21458) then 5-8 (AniList 97853) IS the licensor's published numbering — no re-basing, and the task's premise that season 2 is re-numbered 第1話-第4話 does not hold (flag 2). air_date is the GENERAL Japanese paid-streaming premiere (通常配信, 12:00 JST); the season-1 fan-club advance dates are per-row notes (flag 3). The compilation films and the 2023 TV Edition are not rows (flags 6, 7).

en-WP §Media → Original net animation → Episodes: an {{Episode table}} of 8 rows in two {{Episode table/part}} blocks, each with OriginalAirDate. All 8 dates match the licensor's general-release regime. Contra the task premise, the table is NOT dateless (flag 1).

flags_for_sean: 1. TASK PREMISE STALE (en-WP). The task says en-WP's 8-row table has NO air dates. It does, on every row, and has since at least revision 1293205074 (2025-05-31), where the table already carried a 'Release date' column with OriginalAirDate. The current version (rev of 2026-08-24) is the same data in a richer {{Episode table}}. All 8 en-WP dates match the licensor exactly, so en-WP served as a genuine second source rather than a dead end.

2. TASK PREMISE REFUTED (numbering). The licensor does NOT re-number season 2 as 第1話-第4話. Its live CMS emits one array of episodeNumber 1..8 (subtile 第1話..第8話 / Episode 1..Episode 8), Gundam.info's own announcement writes 「第5話から第8話」, and the legacy site's story art is act01..act08. Only the internal production asset names keep a per-season index (TB_1st_sc_ep01-04, TB_2nd_sc_ep01-04). Our 1-8 IS the licensor's published numbering — the numbering_basis should say so, not claim a re-base.

3. DATE REGIME FORK on eps 1-4 — a curator call. Season 1 episodes had TWO Japanese streaming dates: a 最速先行配信 on the official ガンダムファンクラブ smartphone app, then the general 有料配信 across ~20 services exactly two weeks later. I used the GENERAL date as air_date for all 8 rows because (a) season 2 has no advance window at all, so the general date is the only regime consistent across the whole run; (b) the licensor headlines the general date and explicitly labels the fan-club run 先行 (advance); (c) en-WP frames 12/25 as the premiere and 12/11 as 'early access'. If you prefer the protocol's strict 'first Japanese release', eps 1-4 become 2015-12-11 / 2016-01-29 / 2016-03-04 / 2016-04-08 (all licensor-sourced, all in the row notes) and eps 5-8 are unchanged. One switch, four rows, fully reversible.

4. NO EPISODE SUBTITLES EXIST. The run's episodes carry only an ordinal — 第N話 on the JA licensor site, 'Episode N' on the EN one, and en-WP's table has no Title parameter at all. title / title_native carry the licensor's own labels; there is nothing else to carry, and any subtitle a downstream source offers for these rows is either the 2023 TV Edition's (flag 6) or invented.

5. EP 8 WAS DELAYED. Announced for 2017-06-30, released 2017-07-14 (licensor: 「6月30日正午の配信予定でしたが、諸事情により、7月14日(金)に変更になりました」). Any source keyed to the January 2017 schedule — including the still-live Gundam.info announcement — prints 06-30. 07-14 is the release; 06-30 is an announcement. Related: ANN's 'Episode 8 Previewed in Video' article is dated 2017-06-30 and is a preview, not a release.

6. ja-WP LAYOUT TRAPS — two, on one page. (a) The 各話リスト has a 劇場版 row (DECEMBER SKY, 6月25日 劇場公開) sitting BETWEEN 第4話 and 第5話, plus two colspan season-header rows (第1シーズン / 第2シーズン): a naive row parse yields 9-11 rows, not 8. (b) The SAME page carries a second {{エピソードリスト}} block under §TVエディション — the 2023 MBS/TBS 日5 three-part re-cut of DECEMBER SKY, numbered 第1話-第3話 with real titles 雷 / 水 / 花 (2023-02-12 / 02-19 / 02-26, Sundays). That is the ONLY titled episode table on the page, so a title-hungry scraper lands on it. This is the golden-kamuy shape: scope any scrape to §Webアニメ → 各話リスト and stop at the TVエディション heading.

7. WHICH PAGE CARRIES WHICH RUN. Not rows of this grid: December Sky (AniList 21893, theatrical 2016-06-25, a director's cut compiling eps 1-4, later split 4 ways on TOKYO MX in Oct-Nov 2017 and 2 ways on BS11); Bandit Flower (AniList 99547, theatrical 2017-11-18, re-cut of eps 5-8); and the 2023 TV Edition (3 parts, a re-cut of December Sky, gundam-tb.net/tv/). All three are re-cuts or compilations of the eight ONA episodes in this grid.

8. ANILIST COUNTS NOT RE-VERIFIED. graphql.anilist.co returns HTTP 403 'The AniList API has been temporarily disabled due to severe stability issues' and anilist.co serves a JS shell with no og metadata, so I could not re-read 21458 / 97853. expected_episodes 8 is the 4+4 given in the task, independently corroborated by the licensor's own 1..8 index (8 rows, 8 episodeNumbers, 8 thumbnails). Worth a re-check when the API returns.

9. TWO ANILIST ENTRIES, ONE GRID. The schema's anilist_id holds one id; I put the root entry 21458 there and added anilist_ids [21458, 97853] so the second entry is not lost. Rows 1-4 belong to 21458 and rows 5-8 to 97853 (each row's note says which, with the licensor's asset name as the witness).

10. DAY-OF-WEEK SWEEP CLEAN. Every general-release date is a Friday except ep 7 (Wednesday 2017-05-31), and that irregularity is sourced twice in the licensor's own words (「本日５月３１日（水）」 and 「2017年5月31日（水）」) — real, not a defect. All four season-1 advance dates are Fridays; the 2023 TV Edition dates are Sundays (日5 slot). No unexplained slot break anywhere in the run.

11. MINOR, en-WP prose only (not our data). The ONA paragraph reads 'concluding on 22 April 2016 (with early access for the Gundam Fan Club on 8 December)' — '8 December' is a typo for 8 April (licensor: 2016年4月8日). The episode table itself is correct; flagged only so nobody reconciles our ep-4 note against that sentence and doubts the 04-08 advance date.
